direcaoVisual: Candid photo of [CENA: e.g. a company year-end party, colleagues at a round table raising phones toward a large LED wall], shot from a guest's point of view, slightly tilted framing, between shoulders, smartphone camera look, light grain, warm amber party lights and bokeh (#FFBA4B), deep purple night ambience (#141121), subtle coral accents (#FF4F73), diverse adults in smart-casual clothes, genuine laughter, no posed studio look, no real brand logos, [FORMATO: vertical 4:5 | vertical 9:16], leave clean dark space at the [top|bottom] for a headline. Avoid: visible text, app store screens, fake dashboards, stock-photo smiles.

imagens.cena: a company year-end party at night, a round table of colleagues of clearly different ages and ethnicities (a Black woman in her fifties, a young East Asian man, a gray-haired white man, a Latina woman in her thirties) laughing together, one of them raising a phone toward the stage, seen from behind their shoulders, the phone held so its screen faces away from the camera, the stage itself out of frame so only its warm glow reaches the room

revisao.motivo: Mais espontânea e 'de quem estava lá': risadas de verdade, mesa diversa em idade e origem, luz âmbar e roxo-noite da paleta, faixa escura no topo para a headline. O celular mostra só o visor da câmera; a captura real entra na edição, como manda a campanha.

descartadas.motivo: Todos sorrindo de frente para a câmera: cara de banco de imagem, que a campanha proíbe.
Dois rapazes quase idênticos lado a lado (rosto duplicado).
